card.name: Linking words before drug company names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (by, to, and, for, contact, an opening parenthesis) right before a pharmaceutical company name is expected, such as Novartis, GlaxoSmithKline or Merck.

modes.label: Ties to a company
modes.description: A preposition or 'and' just before a drug maker is named in news about industry links, marketing or sales.
modes.example: Weiss reported financial ties<< to>> the drug company Novartis, and

modes.label: Brand then maker
modes.description: A parenthesis or 'and' after a brand name, where the manufacturer comes next.
modes.example: Cyclobenzaprine HCL Flexeril ® (Merck Sharp & Dohme) Amoxapine Asendin ®<< (>>Lederle) Maprotiline

modes.label: Contact the maker
modes.description: The word contact in an adverse-reaction reporting line, before the company name.
modes.example: To report SUSPECTED ADVERSE REACTIONS,<< contact>> Rare Disease Therapeutics, Inc., at
